settings.heading: Tested by Experts. Trusted by Moms. Loved by Kids.
settings.subheading:
Simply Kids is 100% dermatologically tested, pH 5.5–6.6, toxin-free, and backed by real human efficacy tests — because your child’s skin deserves more than “safe.” Crafted by experts (with wisdom from Nani ♥), our in-house formulas are made for kids aged 4–12 with the highest standards of care.

No guesswork. No compromises. Just clean, effective skin & hair care made for growing bodies. Mindful Parenting Starts Here. #4to12matters

settings.text: I started noticing serious concerns with my little one’s hair and skin — something had to be done! It hit me that kids aged 4–12 need products made just for them. My amazing mother, Nani (also a medicinal plants expert), stepped in and began whipping up homemade shampoos and lotions.
After a bunch of lab tests, we got five essential products ready for my little one — just the basics but exactly what we needed to nurture and nourish her delicate, developing skin and hair texture.

Friends and family couldn’t help but notice the difference — smooth, shiny, and super healthy hair and skin! Talking to other moms, I realized there was a real need for products like these, so the idea for a 4–12 kids’ brand started to take shape.

Countless late nights were spent brainstorming, planning, and envisioning how many ways we could reach every parent and caregiver for this age group and help them achieve their 4–12 year olds’ personal care goals. #4to12matters
Our brand “Simply Kids” was born — a name that perfectly captured and resonated with our mission and vision together!
We finally launched our first Body and Hair range for 4–12-year-olds on Amazon, ready to share the love with more families! #Granny’sLoveInABottle

settings.question: What are the “Naniji ke Nuskhe” that you talk about?
settings.answer: We are a mother-daughter duo with a legacy of care. All our products are toxin-free, safe, and dermatologically tested.

settings.question: Why should I prefer Simply Kids over any other product available in the market?
settings.answer: The market is flooded with baby products, but there are pretty much no products made specifically for children once they grow past toddlerhood into the pre-teen years. Our products are dermatologically tested and contain only the finest, ethically sourced, minimally processed ingredients.

settings.question: What is the recommended age range for Simply Kids products?
settings.answer: The Simply Kids range has been specially developed for children aged 4–12 years.

settings.question: Can babies, teenagers and adults also use your products?
settings.answer: As the name would suggest, Simply Kids products are formulated to specifically suit the personal care requirements of your 4–12 year olds.

settings.question: Do your products use natural ingredients?
settings.answer: As far as possible, yes. Our range of natural ingredients includes almond oil, jojoba oil, bhringraj, and many more.
